# Powrush

> Powrush is a game from Autonomicity Games. If you only take, the glow fades. If you allocate, the climate comes back. The current build is offline and single-player, and it is in active development. Online play is not live. There is no Steam page and no release date. It is not a public launch candidate. This site is https://powrush.com. The company site is https://acitygames.com.

## Status

- Play is coming later. Online play is not available.
- One human, one machine. Offline first. Title Online stays grey.
- The yard is the universe at the scale of a well. The wider story wears five peoples and a stone.
- Walk a climate. Harvest with mercy. Learn a resource-based economy by playing. The lesson is in the hands. It is a teaching, not a wage.
